drums.tags: Funk rock. An electric bass guitar plays a syncopated, percussive slap-and-pop riff featuring rapid sixteenth-note ghost notes and hammer-ons. The bass tone is bright with a mid-range scoop and high-end snap. A clean electric guitar enters with rhythmic, muted scratches and staccato ninth chords on the off-beats. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interlocking rhythmic relationship between the bass and the guitar. The recording has a dry, close-mic studio aesthetic with minimal room reverb.

bass.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid, palm-muted downstrokes and power chord transitions. Overdriven bass guitar follows the guitar root notes with a pick. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with constant eighth-note hi-hat hits and a prominent, dry snare. Male vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery. 180 BPM, 4/4 time signature, Key of E Minor. The guitar tone is mid-heavy with high gain, while the bass has a clanky, metallic high-end. The vocal performance is rhythmic and percussive, sitting forward in the mix with minimal reverb.
